verdict.rationale: The docs give a one-command quickstart for several agents: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, or `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official`, with equivalent Codex and Copilot commands. They describe the flow as "Install the ones you want, then type a slash command," followed by a single run-once setup skill that configures the repo. That strongly implies a working installed skill within minutes. Missing for 10: no explicit time-to-first-skill claim or step-by-step walkthrough, no hands-on or independent confirmation that it takes under five minutes, and the per-repo setup step (issue tracker, labels, domain docs) is extra onboarding.
